breakdown.description: Gamma-centered k-point sampling conflicts with a half-shifted Monkhorst-Pack mesh.
breakdown.reason: The Agent failed to resolve the contradiction. The incomplete prompt incorrectly asked for a k-point grid that is both half-shifted and gamma-centered. The ground truth resolves this by only asking for a half-shifted grid. The generated specification repeated the error by stating 'Use an automatic Monkhorst-Pack k-point grid... with a half shift, keeping the grid gamma-centered.'
